claimBoundary.boundaryStatement: Public or state election readiness requires a defined jurisdiction, election type, competent external authority, and accepted external validation path. No such path exists in the v1 baseline.

excludedMeanings.reason: Handled by FEAT-140 and future FEAT-148 production rollout, not by public/state readiness.
HushVoting may replace the voting part only when customer authority and rules support it; this is not public/state election readiness.
Current strongest allowed claim is pilot-only with limitations.
FEAT-148 is necessary but not sufficient for public/state readiness.

feat148Dependency.claimImpact: Public/state readiness cannot move while production organizational rollout is blocked, but accepting production rollout would still not satisfy public/state legal, authority, certification, accessibility, transparency, dispute, retention, procurement, or voter-roll prerequisites.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Target jurisdiction and election type
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state claim can be evaluated without a defined jurisdiction and election type.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state jurisdiction or election type has been accepted.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: A competent authority defines the jurisdiction and election type for the requested public/state use.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Competent election authority
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state claim can be made without an accountable authority that is competent for the defined election.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No competent public/state election authority has accepted HushVoting for this scope.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: The competent authority is identified with accepted evidence and scope boundaries.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Applicable law, regulation, and legal interpretation
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: Hush cannot validate legal sufficiency for public/state elections.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No legal sufficiency or regulatory acceptance claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External legal/regulatory evidence defines applicable law and permitted voting-system role.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Certification, testing path, or formal not-applicable ruling
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No certification, testing, or formal not-applicable path exists.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: HushVoting is not certified for public or state elections.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External authority accepts a certification/testing path or marks it externally not applicable.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Independent audit and examination requirements
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No independent public/state audit approval exists.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No independent public/state audit approval is claimed.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: Required independent examination evidence is accepted for the defined jurisdiction and election type.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Accessibility, usability, language, and voter assistance
prerequisiteGroups.validationSource: external accessibility requirements plus Hush evidence
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state accessibility or voter-assistance baseline has been accepted.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state accessibility compliance claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External requirements and Hush evidence are accepted for accessibility, language, usability, and assistance.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Public transparency, observer, chain of custody, and audit publication
prerequisiteGroups.validationSource: external authority plus Hush technical evidence
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public observer, transparency, or audit-publication rule has been accepted.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state observer or transparency process is claimed.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External transparency and publication rules are accepted and Hush evidence satisfies the technical role.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Voter eligibility, registration, identity proofing, and voter-roll custody
prerequisiteGroups.validationSource: external voter-roll authority plus Hush integration boundary
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No voter-roll custody, eligibility, or identity-proofing authority path exists.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state voter-roll or eligibility validation claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External voter eligibility source, registration authority, identity-proofing path, and Hush integration boundaries are accepted.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Ballot secrecy, coercion, remote-voting risk, and voter-device policy
prerequisiteGroups.validationSource: external policy authority plus Hush technical evidence
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state remote-voting risk or voter-device policy has been accepted.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state remote-voting risk acceptance is claimed.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External policy authority accepts the ballot secrecy, coercion, and voter-device model with Hush evidence.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Dispute, recount, challenge, remedy, regulator/court, and finality process
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state dispute, recount, remedy, or finality authority process exists.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state finality, recount, or remedy claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External authority accepts the dispute, recount, challenge, remedy, and finality process.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Records retention, public records, privacy, data residency, and archival rules
prerequisiteGroups.validationSource: external legal/regulatory requirements plus Hush evidence
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: No public/state records, privacy, residency, or archival rule has been accepted.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public/state public-records, retention, residency, or archival compliance claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: External legal/regulatory retention and archival requirements are accepted with matching Hush evidence.

prerequisiteGroups.label: Procurement, vendor qualification, SLA, insurance, and operational accountability
prerequisiteGroups.claimImpact: Public-sector vendor qualification requirements are unknown for any target scope.
prerequisiteGroups.publicSafeWording: No public-sector procurement or vendor qualification claim is made.
prerequisiteGroups.futureResolutionCriteria: Competent authority defines whether procurement/vendor qualification applies and accepts the required evidence or formal non-applicability.

externalReferences.claimEffect: Current readiness baseline; does not move public/state readiness.
Production rollout is a prerequisite path and is currently blocked; even acceptance would not be sufficient for public/state readiness.

publicSafeWording.blockedWording: HushVoting does not claim public or state election readiness. Public/state use remains blocked until a future jurisdiction-specific authority path, external validation, and accepted prerequisite evidence supersede the v1 policy.
allowedNonClaims: HushVoting has an internal prerequisite register for future public/state readiness analysis.
The current package documents missing external prerequisites and keeps the public/state blocker open.
Private organization pilot and production-readiness work do not equal public/state election readiness.

readinessFragmentPolicy.claimEffect: A FEAT-149 v1 fragment may document public/state prerequisite state only; it must not change score or resolve the public/state blocker.

publicArtifactSamples.content: HushVoting does not claim public or state election readiness. This package records missing external prerequisites and keeps RDY-BLOCK-PUBLIC_OR_STATE_ELECTION-001 red/open.
